title: hieracium villosum subsp. villosissimum
intro: Hieracium villosum subsp. villosissimum, commonly known as the woolly hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against infections, reduce inflammation, and neutralize free radicals. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium villosum subsp. villosissimum include its ability to act as a diuretic, lowering urine production and blood pressure, and its antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium villosum subsp. villosissimum include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
